header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH AT KARACHI
Date Order with signature of Judge
1. For orders on office objections No. 1.
body: Mr. Ali Asghar, Focal Person, Home Department, Government of Sindh.

ASP Iqbal Hassan DSP, Yousufuddin, Central Prison Karachi, DSP Sajid Gujjar, DSP/Legal on behalf of AIGP Legal CPO. ------------------------------------------ Learned AAG states at the Bar that the detenue Yasir, has been released and, therefore, the petition has become infructuous. In support thereof, he places on record a copy of order issued by the Home Department, Government of Sindh, bearing No. SO(Judl- II)/HD/06-01/2026 (Oct-15) dated 27.10.2026, whereby this Department’s detention orders of even number dated 12.10.2026, 13.10.2026,14.10.2026, 15.10.2026, 16.10.2026 and 19.10.2026, issued under Section 3(1) of the Sindh Maintenance of Public Order Ordinance, 1960, have been withdrawn with immediate effect, including the detention order concerning the detenue, whose name appears at Serial No. 30 in the list of sixty (60) persons. In view of the aforesaid statement made by learned AAG, the petition stands disposed of as having become infructuous alongwith pending application(s), if any.
Judge Head of the Const. Benches J u d g e SAJID
